## Mermaid Diagram Examples

### Flowchart with Different Shapes

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A[Rectangle] --> B(Rounded)
    B --> C{Decision}
    C -->|Yes| D[Result 1]
    C -->|No| E[Result 2]
    D --> F((Circle))
    E --> F
```

### Sequence Diagram

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    participant Author
    participant Editor
    participant Reviewer

    Author->>Editor: Submit package
    Editor->>Reviewer: Request review
    Reviewer->>Editor: Submit review
    Editor->>Author: Send feedback
    Author->>Editor: Resubmit
    Editor->>Author: Approve
```

### Gantt Chart

```{mermaid}
gantt
    title Workshop Schedule
    dateFormat HH:mm
    section Morning
    Introduction           :09:00, 30m
    Presentation 1        :09:30, 45m
    Exercise 1            :10:15, 30m
    section Afternoon
    Presentation 2        :13:00, 45m
    Exercise 2            :13:45, 30m
    Wrap-up               :14:15, 15m
```

### State Diagram

```{mermaid}
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Submitted
    Submitted --> UnderReview
    UnderReview --> ChangesRequested
    UnderReview --> Approved
    ChangesRequested --> UnderReview
    Approved --> [*]
```

### Class Diagram

```{mermaid}
classDiagram
    class Package {
        +String name
        +String version
        +String author
        +install()
        +test()
    }
    class Review {
        +String reviewer
        +Date submitted
        +approve()
        +requestChanges()
    }
    Package --> Review
```

### Pie Chart

```{mermaid}
pie title Package Categories
    "Data Access" : 45
    "Data Visualization" : 30
    "Data Manipulation" : 15
    "Other" : 10
```

### Git Graph

```{mermaid}
gitGraph
    commit
    commit
    branch develop
    checkout develop
    commit
    commit
    checkout main
    merge develop
    commit
```

### Entity Relationship Diagram

```{mermaid}
erDiagram
    AUTHOR ||--o{ PACKAGE : submits
    PACKAGE ||--o{ REVIEW : receives
    REVIEWER ||--o{ REVIEW : writes

    AUTHOR {
        string name
        string email
    }
    PACKAGE {
        string name
        string version
    }
    REVIEW {
        string comments
        date submitted
    }
```

### Mind Map

```{mermaid}
mindmap
  root((rOpenSci Review))
    Submission
      Pre-submission
      Full submission
    Review Process
      Editor assignment
      Reviewer assignment
      Feedback
    Approval
      Package acceptance
      Maintenance
```
